text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder achieved a magnificent result 
in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The "Monster the Second" strikes again!! 
Maruzensky is surely watching this too!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your kind words of concern. 
However... I have no time to be tired.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...If things had gone as they should, 
this race would have been much more—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, I was pretty serious about it, you 
know? How should I put it... it hurts way 
more than just regular frustration.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Losing to an opponent who won't even 
look you in the eye, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Well, at the end of the day, I just 
wasn't strong enough.
